svg.title: How _TC_TOTAL, _DTC, TC_BREAK, E_BREAK are constructed
svg.desc: Five doubling bands stacked on the TC axis show the cumulative cost shares 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 over 31. Horizontal dashed projections run from each band top to the smooth TC of E curve, and vertical drops land on the E axis, producing break points densely packed near the origin and stretching out at the tail.
svg.text: ① _TC_TOTAL = TC(E_MAX). ② Doubling shares 1:2:4:8:16 sum to 2⁵−1 = 31.
③ Cumulative sum on TC axis = TC_BREAK (the band tops). ④ brentq inverts TC(·) point-by-point.
Equal halving on TC ↔ asymmetric stretching on E — dense at origin, sparse in the flat tail.
